home.heroSubtitle: Split's largest beach, reimagined — your complete guide to the Miami of Split
home.beachAreasSubtitle: Discover the different zones of Žnjan Beach
home.storyText1: What was once a neglected stretch of coastline is now Split's crown jewel. The €45.77M transformation brought world-class infrastructure, a palm-lined promenade, and 11 brand-new pavilion venues to life.
home.storyText2: From sunrise coffee at Central Beach to sunset cocktails at Taboo — Žnjan's new pavilion restaurants serve fresh Dalmatian cuisine with Adriatic views. Seven venues, each with its own character.
home.storyText3: Paddleboard at dawn, volleyball at noon, and live music at dusk. With a 1,200m² skate park, children's playground, and amphitheater with a steel dome, there's always something happening.
